recommended_first_slice.name: pinned-read-only-transaction-inspect-adapter-v1
recommended_first_slice.goal: Authenticate one already-staged deterministic upstream bundle against the exact pinned public transaction inspect CLI, attach the genuine plan to the frozen transaction facade, and optionally verify stable_source_id through a separately isolated pinned public function call.
preconditions: proposal already passes validate_transaction in phase=proposal and carries the locally constructed deterministic input_bundle_sha256
bundle.json and content/<sha256> files already exist below one approved .work/<batch>/transaction-inspect directory; this adapter never stages or writes them
vault_root is an explicit existing disposable/test or operator-selected Vault path; inspect is read-only but may read declared targets and preconditions
upstream_root is the exact clean pinned submodule checkout and is authenticated before any upstream Python starts
postconditions: returned transaction is an independent phase=inspected facade with runtime_result=null and raw public-CLI plan attached
returned authority record binds the exact compact bundle bytes, all referenced content bytes, pinned source identity, exact stdout bytes, and attached facade declaration
Vault namespace snapshot is unchanged by the adapter; no claim is made about atime or upstream temporary directories
no approval, apply success, receipt-chain validity, source-ledger merge, or human authorization is inferred

recommended_python_api.signature: inspect_pinned_transaction(proposal: object, *, upstream_root: os.PathLike[str], vault_root: os.PathLike[str], bundle_path: os.PathLike[str]) -> dict[str, object]
recommended_python_api.return: A deep-independent video-paper-wiki.upstream-authority.v1 object whose transaction field is the inspected facade; never returns CompletedProcess, absolute command text, or an apply token wrapper.
recommended_python_api.io: Reads authenticated upstream checkout, bundle/content files and Vault preconditions; executes only sys.executable -I <pinned>/scripts/claude-obsidian.py transaction inspect <absolute bundle> --vault <absolute vault>; captures bounded stdout/stderr; writes nothing.
Pure except immutable packaged schema/profile loading; no caller path read or subprocess.

recommended_python_api.signature: verify_pinned_source_id(*, upstream_root: os.PathLike[str], origin_kind: str, locator: str, content_sha256: str | None, expected_source_id: str | None = None) -> str
recommended_python_api.return: Exact src-<20 lowercase hex> emitted by isolated claude_obsidian.ledgers.stable_source_id; when expected_source_id is supplied it must match.
recommended_python_api.io: Authenticates the same pin, then uses sys.executable -I with a fixed non-caller Python program. No transaction/ledger validator private API and no network.

deterministic_transport.bundle_bytes: UTF-8 json.dumps(object, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False), no BOM and no trailing LF
deterministic_transport.bundle_hash_rule: SHA256(raw bundle bytes) must equal proposal.input_bundle_sha256 and the public plan input_bundle_sha256. This works because pinned transaction.py:1011-1026 uses exactly compact sorted JSON for bundle_sha256; the adapter must fixture this rather than generalize it to another pin.
deterministic_transport.bundle_object: Exactly upstream schema/operation_id/operation_type/expected_hashes/writes/address_requests/source_manifest_updates. Writes preserve facade order and contain exactly path,mode,content_file,sha256. Requests are [] and {}.
deterministic_transport.content_file_rule: Every write uses exactly content/<write sha256>, lowercase ASCII, relative to bundle.json parent, with no absolute path, backslash, dot/dotdot, suffix, alternate spelling or symlink. Equal-byte writes share the same content file. Referenced unique files are ASCII-sorted by digest.
deterministic_transport.content_binding: Each content file is no-follow regular; byte length/hash equals the facade write descriptor. The adapter rejects inline content in this profile. Upstream independently rereads/hash-checks it.
deterministic_transport.read_and_original_state: Never encoded as content files. expected_hashes is exact; current target/read hashes and original modes remain public inspect observations correlated by attach_upstream_inspection.
deterministic_transport.managed_requests: Always address_requests=[] and source_manifest_updates={}; therefore plan input_bundle_sha256 == expanded_bundle_sha256 and changed_paths equals facade writes.

upstream_authority_v1_schema_draft.title: video-paper-wiki.upstream-authority.v1

rules.name: claude-obsidian
rules.verified_files: closed [{path,sha256,size_bytes}] equal an immutable profile-owned exact ASCII-sorted list; caller cannot select it

rules.content_files: closed sorted [{write_path,content_file,sha256,size_bytes}], exact one entry per write with duplicate digest paths allowed to reference the same regular file
rules.stdout_sha256: sha256 of exact public CLI stdout bytes
rules.stdout_size_bytes: bounded integer; stderr must be empty on success and is never persisted as authority material

transaction declaration hash remains the proposal hash; attaching plan does not alter it
plan input and expanded hashes equal transport bundle hash; plan paths/hashes/modes equal transaction writes
plan vault_identity is retained raw as volatile upstream evidence; no absolute vault path is serialized
authority is staging/inspection provenance, not a canonical source ledger, operation receipt, run success, or generation output

error_order.codes: SCHEMA_INVALID or existing frozen TRANSACTION_* code; no filesystem read yet

upstream commit/tree/version/clean checkout/profile file snapshot before execution
bundle no-follow regular/size/strict JSON/exact compact bytes/reconstruction and content_file path/type/hash/size
explicit Vault root identity/safe readability precheck, without mutation
fixed argv/env subprocess start, timeout and bounded stdout/stderr

bundle is no-follow regular/strict JSON/size bounded; relative content_file resolves from bundle parent and is no-follow regular, stable-read and 64MiB bounded.
compact sorted UTF-8 semantic bundle hash; content_file requires declared SHA and exact bytes; create target mode is prepared.
inspect is read-only and returns exact transaction-plan.v1 fields including paths/hashes/modes, input/expanded hashes, vault identity and approval.
stable_source_id is a public non-underscore function; ledger validator recomputes it for file/url/manual source records.
public workflow requires inspect before apply, bundle-relative content_file is supported, limits and no-write validation failure are documented.

suggested_allowed_paths.not_needed: pyproject.toml force-include already packages the complete schemas and catalog directories; no new CLI entry point or dependency is required for this slice.

generation_profile_binding_risks: Frozen base-catalog-v1 lists exactly 13 project implementation files and 25 resources. A new adapter module, schema and authority profile are outside that exact material, so changing adapter behavior would not currently stale base generation.

The upstream profile lists 8 files but public transaction inspect actually executes scripts/claude-obsidian.py and imports claude_obsidian/cli.py plus its import-time module closure; neither entrypoint is in the current 8-file set. The existing profile cannot be cited as complete CLI authority.

Do not silently edit frozen revision1/profile. Architect must freeze either a projection-generation/profile revision that binds adapter files/resources and the actual public-CLI authority profile, or a separately versioned adapter authority digest that VPKB-001 receipts/run manifests and later projection generation explicitly consume.

Raw plan vault_identity and approval are host/Vault volatile and must stay inspection provenance; they must not enter canonical content-generation equality unless a reviewed volatile-field rule says so.

architect_blockers_before_freeze.question: Freeze capture-inspection.upstream_plan_sha256 as which exact value: public plan approval_sha256, SHA256 of exact stdout, or another canonical plan hash. Recommendation: approval_sha256 because it is the upstream-reviewed vault/expanded/prepared binding; authority separately records stdout SHA. Never call input_bundle_sha256 a plan hash.

Freeze how production locates/authenticates upstream. Recommendation for this first repo-local slice: explicit upstream_root allowed only when it is the exact gitlink checkout at commit/tree, porcelain-clean, with a profile-owned complete source snapshot; missing checkout is hard UPSTREAM_PIN_MISMATCH, no download or alternate installed package.
Choose and freeze the generation/profile revision or separate consumed authority digest described above. Current frozen base profile does not cover the new adapter or actual CLI entrypoint.

Freeze whether upstream exit75 remains UPSTREAM_CONFLICT with exit75 and all expected exit2 codes collapse to UPSTREAM_CONTRACT_MISMATCH or preserve a closed raw_upstream_code detail. Recommendation: stable project code plus closed raw code detail; unknown codes/output -> UPSTREAM_EXECUTION_FAILED, never fallback.

Freeze who supplies approved .work root and read-only Vault root, canonical path/symlink rules, and whether a filesystem permission check is required or only before/after mutation sentinel. Do not let an arbitrary caller path become executable authority.

Freeze stable_source_id accepted origin kinds and expected-value behavior. Recommendation: exact upstream file/url/manual domain, nullable content hash as upstream permits, isolated fixed helper after pin verification, full result grammar src-[0-9a-f]{20}; no local algorithm copy.

Freeze upstream-authority.v1 as .work inspection provenance (recommended), not a canonical ledger/receipt/run success. Decide which later receipt/run field binds its hash; existing run-manifest has no authority hash field and must not be silently widened.
